question: Which TWO are responsibilities shared by everyone living in the UK? Select two.
romanUrdu: UK mein rehne wale har shakhs ki DO zimmedariyan kaunsi hain?

choices.text: Look after the area where you live and the environment
Always vote for the governing party

explanation: Shared responsibilities include respecting and obeying the law, looking after yourself and your family, and looking after your local area and environment.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 1.3 The values and principles of the UK: responsibilities

question: When is Halloween celebrated?
romanUrdu: Halloween kab manaya jata hai?
explanation: Halloween is celebrated on 31 October and has roots in an ancient festival marking the beginning of winter.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Did the Bill of Rights of 1689 give women the right to vote?
romanUrdu: Kya 1689 ke Bill of Rights ne aurton ko vote ka haq diya?
explanation: The Bill of Rights did not give women the vote. Women gained limited parliamentary voting rights in 1918 and equal terms with men in 1928.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What is the name of the Test cricket series played between England and Australia?
romanUrdu: England aur Australia ke darmiyan Test cricket series ka kya naam hai?
explanation: The Ashes is the famous series of Test matches between England and Australia.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Before the 18th century, what was the biggest source of employment in Britain?
romanUrdu: 18th sadi se pehle Britain mein rozgaar ka sab se bara zariya kya tha?
explanation: Before the 18th century, agriculture was the biggest source of employment in Britain.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.3 A global power: before the Industrial Revolution

question: In 1314, did the Scots led by Robert the Bruce defeat the English at Bannockburn?
romanUrdu: 1314 mein kya Robert the Bruce ki qiyadat mein Scots ne Bannockburn mein English ko shikast di?

choices.text: Yes, but Scotland was then conquered

explanation: Robert the Bruce defeated the English at Bannockburn in 1314, and Scotland remained unconquered.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Which of these is an example of a criminal offence?
romanUrdu: In mein se kaunsa mujrimana jurm ki misaal hai?

choices.text: Smoking in a public place where it is not allowed

explanation: Smoking in enclosed public places where it is prohibited is against the law and can be a criminal offence.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 5.5 Respecting the law: smoking in public places

question: Which Scottish clan was killed for taking the oath of loyalty late?
romanUrdu: Kis Scottish qabeelay ko wafadari ki qasam der se lene par qatl kiya gaya?
explanation: The MacDonalds of Glencoe were late taking the oath and were killed in the Glencoe massacre.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.6 The Tudors and Stuarts: the Glencoe massacre

question: Which TWO policy areas can the devolved administrations make laws on? Select two.
romanUrdu: Devolved administrations kin DO policy areas mein qanoon bana sakti hain?
explanation: Education and health are devolved. Defence, foreign affairs, immigration, taxation and social security remain under the UK government.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in 1914 led to which war?
romanUrdu: 1914 mein Archduke Franz Ferdinand ke qatl ne kis jang ka rasta khola?
explanation: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in 1914 was the trigger for the First World War.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.4 The 20th century: the First World War

question: What is the capital city of Scotland?
romanUrdu: Scotland ka dar-ul-hukoomat kaunsa hai?
explanation: Edinburgh is the capital city of Scotland and the home of the Scottish Parliament.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Did the 1833 Emancipation Act abolish slavery throughout the British Empire?
romanUrdu: Kya 1833 ke Emancipation Act ne poori British Empire mein ghulami khatam ki?

choices.text: No, it applied only to England
No, it applied only to Scotland

explanation: The Emancipation Act of 1833 abolished slavery throughout the British Empire.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.3 A global power: the slave trade and its abolition

question: What was the clearing of small Scottish farms for large sheep and cattle farms called?
romanUrdu: Chhoti Scottish kheton ko bare gosht aur doodh ke farms ke liye khatam karne ko kya kaha jata tha?
explanation: Scottish landlords destroyed small farms called crofts to make space for large flocks; this became known as the Highland Clearances.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.3 A global power: the Highland Clearances

question: Are the Falkland Islands a British Overseas Territory and part of the United Kingdom?
romanUrdu: Kya Falkland Islands British Overseas Territory hain aur United Kingdom ka hissa hain?

choices.text: They are a British Overseas Territory but not part of the UK

explanation: The Falkland Islands are a British Overseas Territory, but they are not part of the United Kingdom.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Which TWO were battles of the English Civil War? Select two.
romanUrdu: English Civil War ki DO jangon kaunsi thin?
explanation: The king's army was defeated at Marston Moor and Naseby during the English Civil War.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.6 The Tudors and Stuarts: the Civil War

question: What was the name of the activist group that campaigned for women's right to vote?
romanUrdu: Aurton ke vote ke haq ke liye campaign karne wale group ka kya naam tha?
explanation: Members of the women's suffrage movement became known as suffragettes; Emmeline Pankhurst helped found the WSPU.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Which UK view was voted Britain's favourite in 2007?
romanUrdu: 2007 mein Britain ka pasandeeda manzar kaunsa chuna gaya?
explanation: In 2007 television viewers voted Wastwater in the Lake District as Britain's favourite view.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 4.5 Places of interest: the Lake District

question: Who were the first people to live in Britain during the Stone Age?
romanUrdu: Stone Age mein Britain mein rehne wale pehle log kaun thay?
explanation: The first people to live in Britain were hunter-gatherers in the Stone Age.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What was the movement against the authority of the Pope and the Catholic Church called?
romanUrdu: Pope aur Catholic Church ki iqtidar ke khilaf tehreek ko kya kaha jata tha?
explanation: The Reformation was a movement against the authority of the Pope and the ideas and practices of the Roman Catholic Church.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.6 The Tudors and Stuarts: the Reformation

question: How can you apply for a National Insurance number?
romanUrdu: National Insurance number ke liye aap kaise apply kar sakte hain?

choices.text: Online or by phone through the official service
Only by visiting the House of Commons
Only by writing to the monarch

explanation: You can apply for a National Insurance number online or by phone through the official service.

sources.title: GOV.UK: Apply for a National Insurance number
sources.locator: How to apply: online or by phone

question: Which of these is a major horse-racing event in England?
romanUrdu: In mein se England ka koi bara horse-racing event kaunsa hai?
explanation: Royal Ascot is a famous five-day horse-racing meeting in Berkshire.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: How many people form a jury in Scotland?
romanUrdu: Scotland mein jury kitne logon par mushtamil hoti hai?
explanation: A jury has 15 members in Scotland and 12 in England, Wales and Northern Ireland.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What are the 40 days before Easter called?
romanUrdu: Easter se pehle ke chalees dinon ko kya kaha jata hai?
explanation: The 40 days before Easter are known as Lent, a time of reflection and preparation.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: When was the last successful foreign invasion of England?
romanUrdu: England par aakhri kamyab foreign hamla kab hua?
explanation: The Norman Conquest of 1066 was the last successful foreign invasion of England.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
